Stand: an own Pixel Office server started with `node src/pixel-office/main.js --port 0 --dir <outside the project>/stand-…` and SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR set to the same folder; events written only through the real `src/pixel-office/hook.sh` (26 events: main session sample-1 with an owner request, 10 role runs, B launched by A, two ends, Stop) and one orchestrator record through `src/pixel-office/note.js`; the owner journal, its copies and the ports 4780, 4782, 4790 were not used.
